simple.meaning: בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (Bêyth Baʻal Mᵉʻôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “Beth-Baal-Meon , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (H1010) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 13:17, with occurrences in Joshua, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (H1010) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (H1010) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן (Bêyth Baʻal Mᵉʻôwn) / H1010 is traced through Joshua 13:17, Jeremiah 48:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1010. Beth Baal Meon מְעוֺן בַּ֫עַל בֵּית proper name, of a location Joshua 13:47, = מְעוֺן בַּעַל Num 32:38 ; Ezek 25:9 ; 1Chr 5:8 (MI מען בעל & מען בעל בת ) = מְעוֺן בֵּית Jer 48:23 = בְּעֹן Num 32:3 (read probably מען ; compare Dr Sm lxviii ); city assigned to Reuben Josh 13:17 ; Num 32:3 , 38 ; 1Chr 5:8 ; possessed by Moab Jer 48:23 ; Ezek 25:9 ; — modern Ma±în Tristr Moab 303 f. Schick ZPV ii. 1879, 5 Survey EP i. 176 Bd Pal 192 .
